groups.title: Added
items: `bloom-api`, `bloom-common`, `bloom-bukkit`: `Bloom` entry point, platform detection and support policy, capabilities, services, lifecycle, scheduler, messages (chat, action bar, title, boss bar) with an unsupported-feature policy, event subscriptions, cooldowns, durations, caches.
Platform adapters: `bloom-legacy` for 1.7.10 – 1.8.9 and `bloom-modern` for Paper 1.21.1 – 26.3.x.
`bloom-items`: item builder, modern ↔ legacy material names, item flags, persistent item data, custom items, serialization.
`bloom-gui`: inventory menus with buttons, layouts, templates, pagination, back navigation, confirmation and per-player state.
`bloom-config`: YAML configuration with defaults, typed getters with line-numbered errors, validation, object mapping, migrations with backups.
`bloom-storage`: asynchronous SQLite, MySQL and MariaDB access with pooling, transactions, migrations and repositories.
Example plugins, a standalone template project, a real-server self-test harness (`run.sh`, `run.bat`) and the documentation website.
`bloom-doctor`: checks plugin jars (plugin.yml, relocation, adapters, Java level) and verifies every Bukkit/Paper reference against target server APIs.
API manifest (`./gradlew apiManifest`), API reference page, `llms.txt`, `AGENTS.md` and a Claude Code skill for plugin authors.

groups.title: Security
items: Legacy `Items.deserialize` only resolves the classes an item consists of instead of any serializable class.
Untrusted `Placeholder.of` values can no longer inject section-sign formatting into MiniMessage messages.

groups.title: Fixed
items: SQLite on 1.7.10 and 1.8.x servers, whose bundled sqlite-jdbc 3.7.2 rejected the WAL setting and lacks `Connection.isValid`.
Persistent item data was lost on 1.7.10 when the item was copied back to a Bukkit stack.
